summary: Backend testing for Joy Automart B2B portal completed. All 33 pytest cases pass (100%) covering root, products listing/filter/search, auth gating, workshop profile + KYC, orders (COD, credit, MOQ, credit-limit, KYC gating), admin RBAC, stats, KYC decisions, credit limit, order status progression placed→delivered, mark-as-paid credit decrement, product CRUD, KYC file upload via Emergent Object Storage, and file ACL.

minor.issue: Stores externally-issued session_token without uniqueness check; repeated logins for same user create duplicate session rows. Consider upserting or adding a unique index on session_token.

No validation that order exists before short-circuit; returns Mongo doc shape consistently but missing PATCH for marking COD orders paid (only credit decrements credit_used). Behaviour OK for credit; for COD orders is just sets payment_status=paid (acceptable).
Does not validate workshop exists; returns null silently if id is wrong. Recommend 404 when workshop missing.
No stock decrement when an order is placed; product.stock is informational only. Document this if intended.

action_items: Optional: dedupe sessions in /api/auth/session via upsert on session_token.
Optional: return 404 from admin workshop kyc/credit endpoints when workshop_id not found.
Optional: enforce inventory decrement on order placement, or document that stock is display-only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines and mixes models, auth, products, orders, admin, storage. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, orders.py, admin.py, storage.py) before it grows further.
init_storage() is sync (uses requests) and called from async startup + each upload; consider async httpx and caching errors so a transient failure at startup does not leave storage_key None forever.
get_object/put_object are blocking sync calls inside async route handlers — this can block the event loop under load. Prefer httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.
Cookie set with samesite='none' + secure=True is fine for cross-site, but auth/logout uses same flags and works only over HTTPS; document local-dev caveat.
ADMIN_EMAILS check is only at /auth/session creation time; an existing user's role is not re-evaluated on subsequent logins. Consider promoting to admin if email is in ADMIN_EMAILS each login.
Order status state machine is freeform (any valid status accepted from any state). Add transition guard (e.g., cannot move from delivered back to placed).
test_credentials: Test users seeded into MongoDB by conftest.py fixtures (TEST_-prefixed user_ids/sessions) and cleaned up after the session. Auth via Authorization: Bearer <session_token>.
seed_data_creation: Per-session fixtures create: workshop (KYC=approved, credit_limit=50000), workshop_pending (KYC=not_submitted), admin user. All cleaned up post-session. 12 products are auto-seeded by backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (33 cases). Reuses fixtures in conftest.py that mint MongoDB session tokens. Object storage (Emergent) is reachable from this env and KYC upload + signed file fetch both succeed. For frontend testing, reuse the seeded workshop token by injecting cookie 'session_token' on the preview domain (see /app/auth_testing.md Step 3).
